svg.title: Preference data generation and self-refinement workflow
svg.desc: Inventory: left panel contains new input prompts cylinder, current LLM box with flame, sampled response dashed rounded area with two response stacks, implicit reward label band, reference LLM box with snowflake, preference judgment rounded area with blue winning and red losing response stacks plus thumbs icons, arrows and bottom caption. Right panel contains preference data cylinder, simulated LLM dashed box, noisy identified data rounded box with green/red cylinders and check/cross icons, reference/current LLM boxes with snowflake/flame, plus node, straight and curved connections, learning label and bottom caption. Layout is horizontally symmetric by two major panels separated by a pale vertical divider; each local module uses horizontal alignment and orthogonal flow, with the right feedback loop using a curved return arrow.
